blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **благодарности** — благода́рность: gratitude, gratefulness, thankfulness. Wiktionary: благода́рный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: I did smoke when I was young.
exercises.why: **молодости** — мо́лодость: youth (state of being young); youth (period in life). Wiktionary: молодо́й + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **торже́ственность** — grandeur, stateliness, solemnity. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ость», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость).
**старости** — ста́рость: old age; age, years (as the cause of dilapidation or decrepitude); (literary, figuratively) the old, the elderly. Wiktionary: ста́рый + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **красота** — красота: beauty (quality of pleasing appearance). Wiktionary: красный + -ота́.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пустота — emptiness, void; чистота — cleanliness, purity; ра́венство — equality, parity (fact of being equal); седина — gray hair.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ра́венство** — equality, parity (fact of being equal). Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ств», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ств).

exercises.q: Her gray hair makes her look older than her age.
exercises.why: **Седина** — седина: gray hair; (figuratively) great age, old age.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
